about: The tillr backend policy for a jail with a Claude subscription login and GitHub Copilot pi credentials (no Bedrock dispatch). Claude runs with account=subscription so run-claude strips the jail's Bedrock environment and uses the saved OAuth login. The design, plan, review, verify and build seats run Claude on the subscription; scout, edit, test-write, test-run and docs use the Copilot backends directly. These seat choices are the operator's, not the owner's. A drain names this file with --policy; like the other per-machine policy files, this is the stopgap docs/design/tillr-convergence.md OQ-TC2 records.

seat_purposes.design: Settle design decisions and specify the intended change.
seat_purposes.build: Implement the change described by the item or plan.
seat_purposes.review: Review the candidate against the criteria.
seat_purposes.scout: Search the tree and report findings without writing.
seat_purposes.plan: Read the item and tree and write the piece list.
seat_purposes.edit: Apply a settled edit named in the plan.
seat_purposes.test-run: Run a named check and report its result without fixing it.
seat_purposes.verify: Join the pieces and verify the combined result.
